title: Synthesis and characterization of new 1,3,4-thiadiazole derivatives: study of their antibacterial activity and CT-DNA binding.
authors: Sayiner, Hakan S; Yilmazer, Mehmet I; Abdelsalam, Aisha T; Ganim, Mohamed A; Baloglu, Cengiz; Altunoglu, Yasemin Celik; Gur, Mahmut; Saracoglu, Murat; Attia, Mohamed S; Mahmoud, Safwat A; Mohamed, Ekram H; Boukherroub, Rabah; Al-Shaalan, Nora Hamad; Alharthi, Sarah; Kandemirli, Fatma; Amin, Mohammed A
one_liner_zh: 该文合成噻二唑衍生物并研究其抗菌活性及与小牛胸腺DNA的结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA对接但对象为小分子配体而非TF-DNA体系，方法以实验为主、DFT和对接为辅，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: 1,3,4-Thiadiazole molecules (1-4) were synthesized by the reaction of phenylthiosemicarbazide and methoxy cinnamic acid molecules in the presence of phosphorus oxychloride, and characterized with UV, FT-IR, (13)C-NMR, and (1)H-NMR methods. DFT calculations (b3lyp/6-311++G(d,p)) were performed to investigate the structures' geometry and physiochemical properties. Their antibacterial activity was screened for various bacteria strains such as Enterobacter aerogenes, Escherichia coli ATCC 13048, Salmonella kentucky, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Proteus and Gram positive such as Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 25923, Listeria monocytogenes ATCC 7644, Enterococcus faecium, Enterococcus durans, Staphylococcus aureus ATCC, Serratia marcescens, Staphylococcus hominis, Staphylococcus epidermidis, alfa Streptococcus haemolyticus, Enterococcus faecium and found to have an inhibitory effect on Klebsiella pneumoniae and Staphylococcus hominis, while molecules 1, 3 and 4 had an inhibitory effect on Staphylococcus epidermidis and alpha Streptococcus haemolyticus. The experimental results were supported by the docking study using the Kinase ThiM from Klebsiella pneumoniae. All the investigated compounds showed an inhibitory effect for the Staphylococcus epidermidis protein. In addition, the mechanism of the 1-4 molecule interaction with calf thymus-DNA (CT-DNA) was investigated by UV-vis spectroscopic methods.
abstract_zh: 通过苯基硫代氨基脲与甲氧基肉桂酸分子在三氯氧磷存在下反应合成了1,3,4-噻二唑分子（1-4），并采用紫外光谱（UV）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FT-IR）、碳-13核磁共振（(13)C-NMR）和氢-1核磁共振（(1)H-NMR）方法对其进行了表征。进行了DFT计算（b3lyp/6-311++G(d,p)）以研究结构的几何构型和物理化学性质。针对多种细菌菌株筛选了其抗菌活性，这些菌株包括产气肠杆菌（Enterobacter aerogenes）、大肠杆菌ATCC 13048（Escherichia coli ATCC 13048）、肯塔基沙门氏菌（Salmonella kentucky）、铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）、肺炎克雷伯菌（Klebsiella pneumoniae）、变形杆菌属（Proteus）以及革兰氏阳性菌，如金黄色葡萄球菌ATCC 25923（Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 25923）、单核细胞增生李斯特菌ATCC 7644（Listeria monocytogenes ATCC 7644）、屎肠球菌（Enterococcus faecium）、耐久肠球菌（Enterococcus durans）、金黄色葡萄球菌ATCC（Staphylococcus aureus ATCC）、粘质沙雷菌（Serratia marcescens）、人葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus hominis）、表皮葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus epidermidis）、甲型溶血性链球菌（alfa Streptococcus haemolyticus）、屎肠球菌（Enterococcus faecium），并发现其对肺炎克雷伯菌和人葡萄球菌具有抑制作用，而分子1、3和4对表皮葡萄球菌和甲型溶血性链球菌具有抑制作用。实验结果得到了使用肺炎克雷伯菌的Kinase ThiM进行的对接研究的支持。所有研究的化合物均显示出对表皮葡萄球菌蛋白的抑制作用。此外，通过紫外-可见光谱方法研究了1-4分子与小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）相互作用的机制。
